description: List filers with official identity (congressional filers carry their Bioguide ID; executive-branch filers return null with an explanation — identifiers are never invented). Filter by bioguide, by the exact member_id a disclosure row carries, or by a substring of the name as filed. A name search can match several filers; each result carries member_id and bioguide for an exact match. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.

member_id.description: Exact filer identifier from a disclosure row, e.g. nancy-pelosi

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the filer's full name, e.g. pelosi

name: list_members
